New Head of Southern Indian Military Command Assumes Post

Lt General Rajesh Pushkar has taken charge as the new chief of the Southern Command, a key military unit in India. This change comes after his recent command experience during Operation Sindoor. The move is part of routine personnel shifts within the Indian Armed Forces.
